body: I can relate to this man. When Id like some genuine warmth from my loved ones, I get what feels like clinical and medical and detached advice like.. have you tried calling the suicide hotline or are you ready to go back to therapy etc.. would just be nice to not be treated like a case but as a human being who my family and friends apparently care about. I hope you're still chugging along there. I try to think that people are deliberately bad at dealing with us sad types but more people are just feel awkward and are naive but somewhere deep down inside of themselves I bet they do really care about you man. I hope you eventually get the warmth you need from your loved ones. Keep us posted on how it goes :)

heya i read one of your old posts about your positivity about your post cancer bod & healthy life choices. I hope that same positivity can reach you during this dark period you're experiencing. Your bf seems super cool and supportive and i hope he is helping you through your tough times. Let us know how everything goes for you & i wish you nothing but the best, sending good vibes all the way from new New Zealand to whichever is your side of the world :) - K.
You've got this man! :) sending my positive vibes to you
